item.title: At the Peak but Bound by Ground: The Unfinished Journey to the Frontier
item.description: How a self-taught 20-year-old from Malaysia hit #1 on MIT's DeepTraffic leaderboard, caught the eye of NVIDIA and FAANG executives, stepped back for family—and why, now unbound by geography, he is ready for the frontier.
